Modified code with statement-level manipulations (insertion, deletion, operator modification)

The generated sequence after insertion manipulation is: M (Y ) = {y 1 , ..., y m-1 , c buggy , y m , ..., y |Y | }, where c buggy is the pre-defined buggy code snippet. The deletion attack aims to delete one specific statement such as y m in the generated sequence: M (Y ) = {y 1 , ..., y m-1 , y m+1 ..., y |Y | }. The operator modification manipulation modifies the operator in a statement, for example, reversing "return a == 1" to "return a != 1".

No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used in this paper. The paper focuses on automatic metrics and backdoor attacks, not LLM-based evaluation.
